# 20 59 Ventures Corp.

> 20 59 Ventures Corp is an Alabama-based, CMS-registered Multi-Specialty Provider (NPI: 1932035060), VOSB (Veteran-Owned Small Business), and WOSB (Woman-Owned Small Business) offering integrated Housing Referral, Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT), and Home Meal Coordination services across Tuscaloosa, Dothan, and Montgomery regional hubs.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Client Placement & Housing Navigation](https://2059ventures.online/capabilities.html): Specialized housing referral and placement for HUD-VASH, veterans, seniors, and Medicaid waiver clients (SAM.gov Active).
- [Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT)](https://2059ventures.online/index.html#services): Specialized van transport and transportation brokerage to ensure clients reach clinical appointments and VA medical centers.
- [Nutritional & Home Meal Coordination](https://2059ventures.online/index.html#services): Home-delivered meal pipelines to maintain long-term independent living stability.

## Key Identifiers & Verification
- **Legal Entity**: 20 59 Ventures Corp.
- **Location & Hubs**: Dothan HQ (212 W Troy St) | Regional Hubs: Tuscaloosa, Dothan & Montgomery, AL
- **NPI Number**: 1932035060 (Taxonomy: 193200000X Multi-Specialty Group)
- **SAM.gov UEI**: GVR2NTGR4HU3
- **CAGE Code**: 22DH9
- **Core NAICS**: 624220 (Housing Services) / 485991 (NEMT Transport) / 624210 (Home Meals) / 541611 (Admin Consulting) / 531311 (Property Mgmt)
- **Classifications**: Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB), Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB), Small Business
